          (3): Conv2d(512, 512, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
        )
      )
    )
    (out_proj): Sequential(
      (0): GroupNorm(
        (gn): GroupNorm(32, 512, eps=1e-06, affine=True)
      )
      (1): Conv2d(512, 16, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1))
    )
  )
)
